patch.value:
Three additive offline-analytics enhancements:

1. `pm pm-graph topo-sort` — valid topological execution order over structural edges via Kahn's algorithm; deterministic (id-sorted ties); exits 1 on a cycle, reporting the cycle path and resolvable prefix. Honors --root/--depth/--include-closed.
2. `pm pm-graph impact <id>` — reverse-reachable set: all items transitively blocked-by/downstream of <id>, with count. Complements path/neighbors.
3. `analyze` extended with dependency-depth: maxDepth + depthByItem[] (longest path from each item to a leaf). Additive fields only; existing output unchanged.

All backward-compatible. New pure helpers (topoSort/reverseReachable/dependencyDepths) covered by unit tests; functionally verified against real workspaces incl. the cycle case.
Add topo-sort, impact, and dependency-depth analytics
